name: Logitech G502 X
notes: 83-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Logitech G502 X, from a dump of the device: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/-/project/147/uploads/69c4af02a2244fc361ec35c3090e11ce/recording.yaml. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
